datasets.name: Payments
datasets.sql:
SELECT id,  hdate, facticaldebt, interestdebt,clientdebt,trid, inttrid,tranchesid,description
  FROM dm_payments
  where id# = :ContractID
order by hdate

datasets.name: CreditAccs
datasets.sql:
select 
       id,
       acc_no,
       name
from account 
where close_dat is null
and  bal_cn1 in ( select accgroup from 
dm_acc_zone_info where zoneid = (select zoneid from dm_acc_zones
where name = 'Account'))
order by acc_no

datasets.name: DepositInfo
datasets.sql:
select
     cust.name,
     cont.amount,
     cont.currency,
     cont.customerid,
     cs.facticaldebt,
     cs.facticalinterestdebt,
    (select ostat from tenostat where acc_id=ca.clientaccid) ostat
from customers cust,
     dm_history_currstate cs,
     dm_contracts cont,
     dm_contract_accounts ca
where
   cont.id = :ContractID 
  and 
   cust.id = cont.customerid
  and 
   cs.id# = :ContractID 
  and
   ca.id# = :ContractID

datasets.name: CustAcc
datasets.sql:
select clientaccid 
       ,dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccount(ContractAccID) as ContractAccNo
       ,dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccount(InterestAccID) as InterestAccNo
       ,dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccount(ClientAccID)   as ClientAccNo
from dm_contract_accounts
where id# = :Contractid
